mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO user_action (user_id, target_id, action_type, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{targetId}, #{actionType}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT target_id FROM user_action WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND action_type = 2 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_action WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND action_type = 2
SELECT target_id FROM user_action WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND action_type IN (1, 2)
SELECT user_id, target_id FROM user_action WHERE action_type IN (1, 2)
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM user_action ua JOIN video_info v ON ua.target_id = v.video_id WHERE v.user_id = #{userId} AND ua.action_type = 1 AND ua.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{sinceDays} DAY)

SELECT DATE(ua.create_time) AS date, COUNT(1) AS count FROM user_action ua JOIN video_info v ON ua.target_id = v.video_id WHERE v.user_id = #{userId} AND ua.action_type = 1 AND ua.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(ua.create_time) ORDER BY date
